title: stainless steel double walled pitcher with ice guard
text: stainless steel double walled pitcher with ice guard. I purchased 2 of these stainless steel double walled pitchers, with ice guard.  They are smaller, but just about the perfect size for us.  I am a little concerned about the seam that appears to have been welded (?) at the to of the pitcher.. see pics I have provided with my review.  Also, I chose the brushed stainless, but the ice guard is a shiny (not brushed) surface so that looks a little - odd.  The ice guard stops large pieces of ice, but allows smaller pieces through.  Because it is doubled walled, it doesn't sweat, which is good.  The romance card inside of the pitcher says they are not meant for hot liquids - but not sure why that would be a problem with stainless.  It also says it is 'dishwasher' safe - but I definitely hand washed. It has some weight, but I would call it a reasonable weight for the price. The handle is comfortable and easy to lift and pour the pitcher.  Time will tell if it is a good enough quality stainless steel that it won't rust.  Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
